m1.why: 填名词 addict（网瘾者）；卷面作 a addict，冠词疑误应为 an，故存疑。

m2.why: much 修饰不可数名词，too much pressure 意为「压力太大」，由首字母 p 提示。

c1.why: deal with 意为「处理问题」；think about 只表考虑，come up with 后接办法。

c2.why: manage to do sth 表示「设法做成某事」，强调结果成功，故填 to get。

c3.topic: it is kind of sb to do
c3.why: kind、nice 等描述人的品质时用 of sb；后一空用不定式 to listen 与 give 并列。

c4.why: focus on sth 意为「专注于某事」，focus more on my schoolwork。

c5.why: 下文 relax ourselves「放松自己」提示是压力，too much pressure 压力过大对健康不利。

c6.why: be/get addicted to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词，故用 to watching。

s1.why: mess up 意为「弄乱」；代词 them 要放在动词与副词之间，即 mess them up。

s2.why: 「有……的好习惯」= have a good habit of doing sth；Lily 第三人称单数用 has，五空依次 has / a / good / habit / of。

s3.why: go on a diet 意为「节食」，just go on a diet to lose weight 结构完整。

s4.why: 「向某人征求建议」= ask sb for advice；advice 不可数，不加 s；三空依次 ask / for / advice。

s5.why: 「负责组织」= be in charge of organizing；organizing 作介词 of 的宾语，须用动名词；四空依次 in / charge / of / organizing。

t1.answer: He often helps in the old people's home.
alt: He often helps in the nursing home.
He often helps at the old people's home.
t1.why: 按 S+A+V+A 排：He often helps in the old people's home。

alt: Jane's speech makes me feel excited.
t2.why: 按 S+V+O+C 用 make sb + 形容词作宾补：Jane's speech makes me excited。

t3.answer: I bought my father some tea last weekend.
alt: I bought some tea for my father last weekend.
Last weekend I bought my father some tea.
t3.why: 双宾 buy sb sth：I bought my father some tea，last weekend 作状语。
